subject: Basic Digital Literacy
content: Spreadsheet software (Excel, Google Sheets) organizes data in rows and columns. Cells are intersections of rows (numbers) and columns (letters) - example A1. Enter data: text, numbers, formulas. Formulas start with = sign: =A1+B1 adds cells, =SUM(A1:A10) adds range, =AVERAGE(B1:B20) calculates mean. Formatting: bold headers, number formats (currency, percentage), borders, colors. Charts: select data, insert chart (bar, line, pie). Nigerian uses: tracking expenses, budgeting, grading students, sales records.
summary: Spreadsheets organize data in rows/columns. Cells (A1). Formulas =SUM, =AVERAGE. Charts visualize data.

quiz_questions.question: What is a spreadsheet cell?
quiz_questions.explanation: Cells are individual data entry points.

subject: Basic Digital Literacy
content: Presentation software (PowerPoint, Google Slides) creates slide shows. Best practices: one idea per slide, minimal text (6x6 rule), readable fonts, high-contrast colors, relevant images, consistent design. Use transitions sparingly. Include title slide, agenda, content slides, conclusion. Practice speaking, don't read slides.
summary: Presentation software: PowerPoint, Google Slides. One idea per slide, 6x6 rule. Engage audience.

quiz_questions.question: What is 6x6 rule?
options: 6 words per line 6 lines per slide
quiz_questions.correct_answer: 6 words per line 6 lines per slide

subject: Basic Digital Literacy
content: Digital citizenship is responsible technology use. Nine elements: digital access, commerce, communication, literacy, etiquette, law, rights/responsibilities, health, security. Nigerian digital citizens: protect personal info, avoid cyberbullying, respect copyright, think before posting, balance screen time, use strong passwords.
summary: Digital citizenship = responsible tech use. Nine elements. Protect privacy, avoid cyberbullying, respect copyright.

subject: Basic Digital Literacy
content: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is code for webpages. Tags in angle brackets < >. Basic structure: , , , <body>. Common tags: <h1> heading, <p> paragraph, <img src='image.jpg'> image, <a href='url'>link</a>, <ul><li>list</li></ul>. Save as .html, open in browser.
summary: HTML structures webpages. Tags: h1, p, img, a, ul. Save as .html.

subject: Basic Digital Literacy
content: Cybersecurity protects computers, networks, and data from attack. Threats: malware (viruses), phishing (fake emails), hacking, identity theft. Protection: antivirus software, firewalls, updates, strong passwords, two-factor authentication (2FA). Nigerian agencies: NITDA, ngCERT. Report cybercrime.
summary: Cybersecurity protects against malware, phishing, hacking. Use antivirus, updates, strong passwords, 2FA.

quiz_questions.question: What is phishing?
quiz_questions.explanation: Phishing impersonates real companies to steal info.
